test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.

Father said, “On the news tonight they mentioned a possibility of a power strike.”

options.text: Father said that on the news that night they had mentioned a possibility of a power strike
Father wondered why on the news tonight they mentioned a possibility of a power strike.
Father asked if on the news that night they had mentioned a possibility of a power strike.
Father said that on the news tonight they mentioned a possibility of a power strike.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Father said that on the news that night they had mentioned a possibility of a power strike'/**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**The given sentence is in the past tense.

__
 
• To convert from direct to indirect, we need to follow some basic rules.
 
• **Inverted commas (, ") **will be changed into '**that'.**
 
• **tonight **will be changed into **'that night'.**
 
• **The past indefinite tense **will be changed into **'the past perfect tense'.**

On the basis of the above-given information, the sentence should be - ***'Father said that on the news that night they had mentioned a possibility of a power strike.'***

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's understand the** concept with some more examples.**

 
• He said, "They called me up yesterday for a specific reason."

 
 
• *He said that they had called him up the day before for a specific reason.*
 
 
 
• She said, "They bought a t.v. a day before yesterday.
 
 
• *She said that they had bought a t.v. two days before.*
